notes: Star graph (hub at node 0). A tree has zero cycles; at γ=1.0 every node prefers the singleton community except the hub, but Louvain/Leiden guarantee that on a tree no internal-edge-weighted cut improves modularity above the all-singleton assignment, so the converged partition is one community (modularity = 0). SC-002 reference; documents the degenerate-γ boundary at which a tree collapses.
